passages.question: How are salaried employees' hours reported?
passages.excerpt: For most businesses the unit of exposure is the hours worked by their employees. ... Salaried employees: You must select one of the following methods to report your salaried employees: Actual hours worked; or Assumed hours of one hundred-sixty hours per month. All salaried employees of an employer must be reported by the same method. You cannot report some salaried employees based on the actual hours they work and others using the one hundred sixty hours per month method.
